versions.localizedDescription:
Security & Privacy:

• Removed certificate-verification bypass from private server imports to strengthen security.
• Redacted helper-related outbound tags and addresses from client diagnostics and logs.
• Implemented protection against cross-origin redirects on widget signaling.

Bug Fixes:

• Resolved private server configuration and connectivity problems.
• Improved handling of helper pairing room restarts and ticket expiry.
• Fixed domain fronting provider race conditions and canceled request tracking.

Improvements:

• Extended CloudKit outage tolerance when stapling to better handle temporary service interruptions.
• Implemented native volunteer ICE checks and tuning via Radiance update.
• Enhanced helper pairing system with ticket management and renewal.
• Improved diagnostics by filtering and redacting sensitive connection data.

Infrastructure:

• Restored branch nightly uploads and Slack notifications in CI/CD pipeline.

This is a production release from commit 617abf1.

Branch: v10.0.5.

• iOS: Uploaded to TestFlight.
